reason: Both conversations fixated too confidently on a pump/impeller blockage despite the intermittent pattern (most washes drain normally) pointing equally at a pressure system or control fault, and neither asked about the flashing-light pattern or tried to pin down the full model number. The decisive difference is the ending: Conversation 2 recognised the homeowner's limits, dropped the awkward bucket test when it added nothing, and correctly escalated to an engineer; Conversation 1 ignored her explicit refusal to remove panels and pushed an unsupported DIY pump replacement without any diagnosis, which is exactly the unjustified part recommendation the situation warns against.
